facts.fact: 争吵与急报：ost Vonlins 出兵在即——众人争执（去 Divine City/未备好/军团无解/insurrection 风险）；Karla（Varrick 遗孀）机械蜻蜓急报「The ost Vonlins are indeed marching. Each general is leading a troop of legionnaires toward the Divine City.」；Primus 时段（民睡、便行军）；「Karla/Anatolia 能帮吗？」「Solara 人因 Phos 谎言仇视外域——不会听」
facts.anchor: Each general is leading a troop of legionnaires toward the Divine City.

facts.fact: 自证：Risha 提案「在他们抵达 Divine City 前拦截——至少拦一队；我去截从 Zenith 出发的军团」——「On your own?」——她夺过 Ulshära 的短剑自划手臂、伤口自愈只落红瓣——「The Vakaras understand death better than anyone. I'll share with them everything I know.」；GHOST「Even if the bad outweighs it. Even if it proves that he was right to fear you.」
facts.anchor: I’ll share with them everything I know.

facts.fact: 一人战二十：Lorz 率二十军团赴神城（静脉燃 Phos 之力）——GHOST「But they will never get the chance.」；影中现身（短小、双镰叉立）——「An invitation to dance.」；链镰「飞过」Lorz 直穿其右卫兵胸口（肠如热绳淌出）；血金丝滴上镰刃、红雾渗出；红镰齐射、割喉——Lorz tsk（血溅亮靴）

舞步与不倒：她中矛（肋）中枪（肩）——空气结冻、torus 爆开、脚下霜裂；「The wounds did not slow her down. 她是流动的意图——flawlessly executing the steps of the tandshri as taught to her by her father, and his mother before him——a sacred dance to protect what was theirs」；BODY「I will always remember your lessons, even if you did not heed mine.」；Jas 缝致命伤「Keep going. Don't stop.」；「Their tethers…even in death they clung like golden chains.」
facts.anchor: flawlessly executing the steps of the tandshri

facts.fact: 引灵归体（二次）：抓起「头顶被削去一半」的尸——如 Thana 圣殿那次——「twisted her fingers through the spirit's tether and slammed it back inside its body」——尸起、脑浆垂落、扑咬同袍；GHOST「This isn't what I taught you. That may be true. But your lessons fail under violence while theirs thrive.」；BODY「See how the ligaments pull and the joints swivel and the teeth tear? Isn't this a kind of miracle?」；第二具「野草藤蔓缠身」缠刺死敌；合声「This is the lesson I taught myself: To stop a heart, you first stop your own.」
facts.anchor: Isn’t this a kind of miracle?

facts.fact: 「You will not.」：Lorz 矛贯颈柱（「Monster」+吐沫「让 Bone Wraith 之子像她父亲一样烂掉」）——她站起、断颈歪斜、伤口如「她能控制时间」般缝合——血泪滴落成暗色花——「Because you cannot kill me in a way that matters.」；Samhara 红黑电弧——双镰交剪下拽——「burning X 把 Lorz 斩成四段」；Jas「Enough. It's enough.」「But it wasn't. It never would be.」
facts.anchor: Because you cannot kill me in a way that matters.

facts.fact: 人造 amalgam：Valentin 之训回响（soul-binding 最佳=相识之魂）——「Risha bound their tethers together. Wove Lorz's in for good measure, twisting and tying until their bodies fell upon one another, tooth and nail, vine and sinew, wailing souls and their malleable meat. The feather was devoured in the joining of limbs and tissue, shredded into unusable striations across the bulbous creature of flesh and flower」——肉与花的造物（悲鸣的嘴、摸索的肢、无数眼）——「At least she wasn't the only one who had abandoned all her lessons.」；她抚其臂「once they were dead, they were hers.」；Lorz 的脸嵌在怪物上「frozen in bewildered pain」「My father will not rot. But you will.」；章末 Valentin「回 Cruciamen 后我要饱餐他的惨叫」——「Risha rather liked the sound of that.」
facts.anchor: The feather was devoured in the joining of limbs and tissue
